coordinate_frame: ego: X forward, Y left, Z up
visibility_rule: provisional pinhole: camera-center depth is within center_depth_range_m and the near-plane-clipped cuboid projection rectangle intersects the image; projected center and minimum pixel size are not eligibility filters
prediction_domain_rule: retain top-K by score/index per frame, then apply the same pinhole depth and image-intersection rule as ground truth
matching_rule: confidence-ranked one-to-one strict ego-XY center distance
unsupported_class_policy: AP is null; supported macro excludes it; all-eight macro uses zero
